entities.name: Query ClpX
observations: 418 aa sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein Q2G3T4 from Novosphingobium aromaticivorans.
Annotated as the ATP-dependent specificity component of the Clp protease; directs substrates to ClpP and can act as a chaperone without ClpP.
Contains an N-terminal ClpX zinc-binding domain, a central AAA+ ATPase domain, and a C-terminal ClpB_D2-small-like region.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is approximately 45.6 kDa and predicted pI is 5.60.

entities.name: ClpP protease
observations: Proteolytic partner of ClpX in the ClpXP ATP-dependent protease complex.

entities.name: AAA+ ATPase
observations: Query contains Pfam AAA-family signatures, including AAA_2 and AAA, spanning approximately residues 112–309.
Conserved P-loop motif includes VGPTGSGKT around residues 115–123, supporting ATP binding and hydrolysis.

entities.name: ClpX zinc-binding domain
observations: N-terminal C4 zinc-binding domain detected at approximately residues 14–50 by Pfam zf-C4_ClpX; reference annotation places the ClpX-type ZB domain at residues 3–56.
